∀ {n : Nat} (direction : Research.TriangularSolve.Direction) (ops : Research.TriangularSolve.Arithmetic)
  (T : Matrix.{0, 0, 0} (Fin n) (Fin n) Real) (b : Fin n → Real) (u : Real),
  LE.le.{0} 0 u →
    Research.TriangularSolve.Triangular direction T →
      Ne.{1} (Matrix.det.{0, 0} T) 0 →
        LT.lt.{0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑n) u) 1 →
          Research.TriangularSolve.ExecutionValid u direction ops T b →
            ∃ ΔT,
              And
                (Eq.{1}
                  (Matrix.mulVec.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} T ΔT)
                    (Research.TriangularSolve.computedSolution direction ops T b))
                  b)
                (And (Research.TriangularSolve.Triangular direction ΔT)
                  (∀ (i j : Fin n),
                    LE.le.{0} (abs.{0} (ΔT i j))
                      (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Research.TriangularSolve.gamma n u) (abs.{0} (T i j)))))
